playercharacters.menu.title: Player Characters
playercharacters.menu.default.tooltip: What every player looks like unless you pick something else for them.
playercharacters.menu.talking_mouths.too: Open the character's mouth while that player talks in voice chat.
playercharacters.menu.farts.tooltip: Farts from the emote wheel, and when a player types "fart" in chat: they bend over and fart. Off: no farts at all.
playercharacters.menu.middle_finger.tool: The middle finger from the emote wheel, and when a player types "fuck you" or "fuck off" in chat: their character shows the middle finger and looks mad for a few seconds. Off: none at all.
playercharacters.menu.emote_music.toolti: Dances from the emote wheel play a short note block tune, or your own music from the Music folder. Its volume is the "Jukebox/Note Blocks" volume in the sound settings.
playercharacters.menu.share_emotes.toolt: Your emotes and the character you picked for yourself are told to the other players as /me chat messages, like "* Steve waves" or "* Steve is playing as Black Wolf". Players who have this mod then see your character and its emotes, and everyone else reads the message.
playercharacters.menu.others_picks.toolt: Players who have this mod are shown as the character they picked for themselves. Turn this off to pick for them yourself.
playercharacters.menu.their_pick.tooltip: %s picked this with Player Characters. Turn off "Their own picks" to choose for them yourself.
playercharacters.menu.open_folder.toolti: Put 3D model folders or skin PNG files in this folder, then click Reload.
playercharacters.menu.music_folder.toolt: Put .ogg music files here named after emotes ("Default Dance.ogg") and those emotes play them instead of their note block tunes.
playercharacters.status.none: No characters yet: add skins to the characters folder
playercharacters.status.no_voice_chat.to: Install Simple Voice Chat to make mouths move when players talk.
playercharacters.picker.random.desc_all: Each player gets one of your characters
playercharacters.emote_wheel.hint: Point or scroll to choose, click to play. Walk while dancing, sneak to stop.
